items.title: Sandisk And 2 Cash Flow Stocks To Watch

items.title: Teradata (TDC) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Split On AI Upside
items.summary: Teradata has seen its modelled fair value price target move from US$33.50 to US$35.38, with some external targets referenced in recent research shifting into ranges between the high US$20s and about US$40. More constructive analysts link higher targets to the potential for stronger growth and earnings if Teradata can better convert its AI and data platform into revenue. items.title: Citigroup (C) Replaces Equities Executive David Haldane With Rob Smolen
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) has reshuffled leadership in its equities division, replacing global derivatives and EMEA equities head David Haldane. Rob Smolen, previously global head of exotics and hybrids trading, will take over Haldane's responsibilities in the equities business. The management change alters oversight of global derivatives and EMEA equities trading, which are key parts of Citigroup's securities unit.
